# Berlin Move-Out Checklist for a 2-Bedroom Apartment

A practical end-of-lease checklist for **2026-06-30** in Berlin, with the key handover items, cleaning tasks, meter readings, and a ready-to-send landlord message in **German and English**.

## End-of-Lease Handover Plan

• **6–8 weeks before move-out**
- Review your lease for notice period, repainting clauses, and handover requirements.
- Ask the landlord or property manager whether they want a formal inspection before the final day.
- Start collecting receipts, photos, and utility account details.

• **2–3 weeks before move-out**
- Book professional cleaning if needed, or plan a deep clean yourself.
- Repair small damage you caused, if allowed and appropriate.
- Confirm the handover appointment time and who will attend.

• **Final week**
- Take meter readings for electricity, gas, water, and heating if applicable.
- Photograph every room, appliances, balcony, windows, floors, and any existing wear.
- Return all keys, remotes, fobs, parking permits, and mailbox keys.

• **Move-out day: 2026-06-30**
- Do a final cleaning and trash removal.
- Walk through the apartment with the landlord or agent.
- Sign the handover protocol only after checking the condition notes carefully.

## Move-Out Checklist by Category

| Area | What to Do | Proof to Keep |
|---|---|---|
| Cleaning | Deep clean kitchen, bathroom, floors, windows, baseboards, and inside cabinets | Before/after photos |
| Kitchen | Clean oven, stovetop, extractor hood, fridge, dishwasher, and sink | Photos of appliances |
| Bathroom | Descale taps, shower, tiles, toilet, mirror, and drains | Photos of fixtures |
| Living areas | Dust, vacuum, remove nail hooks if required, wipe marks from walls | Room photos |
| Balcony / storage | Sweep balcony, empty storage spaces, remove all personal items | Photos of empty spaces |
| Meter readings | Record electricity, gas, water, and heating meters on handover day | Close-up meter photos |
| Keys | Return all keys, copies, chips, fobs, garage remotes, and mailbox keys | Key return confirmation |
| Deposit | Keep handover protocol, final utility bills, and correspondence | Signed protocol copy |

## Cleaning Tasks for a Berlin Apartment

- **Kitchen**
  - Clean oven, hob, extractor hood, fridge, freezer, sink, and cabinets inside/out.
  - Remove grease from backsplash and handles.
  - Empty and wipe trash bins.

- **Bathroom**
  - Descale showerhead, taps, and tiles.
  - Clean toilet thoroughly, including behind and around the base.
  - Remove mold spots if present and safe to clean.

- **Bedrooms and living room**
  - Vacuum carpets or mop hard floors.
  - Dust skirting boards, radiators, shelves, and window sills.
  - Remove all personal items and check drawers/closets.

- **Windows and surfaces**
  - Clean interior windows and visible frames.
  - Wipe fingerprints, marks, and dust from switches and doors.

- **Final trash removal**
  - Dispose of all waste, old cleaning supplies, and forgotten items.
  - Check cellar, attic, bike room, and communal storage.

## Deposit and Documentation Folder

Keep one folder, digital and/or printed, with:

- Signed lease agreement
- Move-in inventory protocol, if you have it
- Photos from move-in and move-out
- Meter reading photos with date
- Handover protocol signed by both sides
- Receipts for cleaning, repairs, and replacements
- Written communication with landlord/property manager
- Proof of key return

## Landlord Message to Send

### German
**Betreff:** Wohnungsübergabe zum 30.06.2026

Sehr geehrte/r [Name],

hiermit möchte ich mich wegen der Wohnungsübergabe zum Ende meines Mietverhältnisses am **30.06.2026** melden.
Bitte teilen Sie mir mit, wann ein Übergabetermin für Sie passend ist und ob Sie für die Abnahme ein Übergabeprotokoll verwenden möchten.

Ich werde die Wohnung bis dahin vollständig geräumt und gereinigt übergeben. Außerdem werde ich die Zählerstände am Übergabetag dokumentieren und alle Schlüssel zurückgeben.

Vielen Dank für Ihre Unterstützung.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
[Ihr Name]

### English
**Subject:** Apartment handover on 2026-06-30

Dear [Name],

I am writing regarding the apartment handover at the end of my tenancy on **2026-06-30**.
Please let me know a suitable time for the handover and whether you would like to use a handover protocol.

I will make sure the apartment is fully vacated and cleaned by then. I will also document the meter readings on the handover day and return all keys.

Thank you for your support.
Kind regards,
[Your Name]
